title: Opposition
use_cases: Use when building a connection between characters without direct interaction
Implement when using a common enemy to force diverse personalities together
Configure when structuring a story around a large-scale impactful event
Use when exploring contrasting reactions to the same external stressor
content:
A shared antagonist (or force of opposition) can sometimes create the point of confluence between the two characters. Two children of an abusive father. Two passengers aboard a derailed train. Two rebels fighting an oppressive regime.

A subset of the shared antagonist may be a shared event scenario. You take an impactful event like a tsunami or a school shooting and you show us how two people react to that event. The characters may never actually interact.
